name: Jacquard
description: Two cloths woven into one: a block figure on the face with the reverse showing through where it lifts.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 0, 60% 0, 60% 60%, 0 60%); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 60% 0, 60% 60%, 0 60%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(40% 40%, 100% 40%, 100% 100%, 40% 100%); clip-path: polygon(40% 40%, 100% 40%, 100% 100%, 40% 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
